tax.text: Casar says the ultra-rich should pay more in taxes to support schools, roads, and community services.
tax.quote: Congress must ensure that the ultra rich pay their fair share in taxes and contribute to the schools, roads, and community services that we all use.

wages.text: Casar co-sponsored the PRO Act and said workers deserve unions that can protect their rights and hold employers accountable.
wages.quote: Especially in a right-to-work-for-less state like Texas, workers deserve a union to protect their rights, create safer workplaces, and hold exploitative employers accountable.

debt.text: Casar has called for defending Social Security and Medicare and supports legislation to expand Social Security benefits.
debt.quote: We're already seeing the chaos being caused by the Republican conference, and I know that folks in Texas want to see us defend baseline programs like Social Security and Medicare and continue to chip away against Texas abortion ban.

housing.text: Casar supports repealing the federal cap that prevents a net increase in public-housing units.
housing.quote: That’s why I support repealing the Faircloth Amendment, which prohibits a net increase in the amount of public housing units.

schools.text: Casar opposes school vouchers and has sponsored federal funding for public schools.
schools.quote: Furthermore, top Texas officials are advocating for a school voucher scam that would make matters worse for students and teachers.

safety.text: Casar crafted an Austin plan that shifted police funding toward violence prevention and alternative public-safety programs.
safety.quote: These immediate cuts would include eliminating funding from three planned police cadet classes and reallocating funds to areas like violence prevention, food access and abortion access programs.

immigration.text: Casar introduced a resolution supporting more legal migration pathways and a roadmap to citizenship.
immigration.quote: We should create more legal pathways for migration and citizenship, while also changing the failed U.S. policies that cause displacement abroad and force people to flee their home countries

guns.text: Casar supports an assault-weapons ban, expanded background checks, and a federal gun-violence-prevention office.
guns.quote: I support legislation to ban assault weapons, expand background checks, and establish a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention.

abortion.text: Casar is an original co-sponsor of the Women's Health Protection Act to restore abortion rights.
abortion.quote: Casar is an original co-sponsor of the Women’s Health Protection Act to restore abortion rights to all Texans, the PRO Act to expand worker rights, and Medicare For All to win health care as a basic right.

gender.text: Casar opposed legislation imposing birth-sex-based school-sports rules and publicly defended transgender athletes' participation.
gender.quote: And so, like any other athlete, trans athletes sometimes win, sometimes they lose.

cannabis.text: As an Austin council member, Casar led a proposal to effectively end arrests and fines for low-level marijuana possession.
cannabis.quote: If there’s no intent to sell or distribute, we’re not going to mess with it,” said Greg Casar, the lead sponsor of the proposal.

health.text: Casar is an original co-sponsor of Medicare for All and describes health care as a basic right.
health.quote: Casar is an original co-sponsor of the Women’s Health Protection Act to restore abortion rights to all Texans, the PRO Act to expand worker rights, and Medicare For All to win health care as a basic right.

energy.text: Casar co-sponsors the Green New Deal and supports expanding clean-energy employment while assisting fossil-fuel workers through the transition.
energy.quote: I’m a proud co-sponsor of the Green New Deal and similar legislation to create good union jobs in clean energy and protect communities harmed by pollution and natural disasters.
